"'''The Princess and the Jedi / Kai's Bad Day'''" is the ninth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 2]], [[2023]].<ref name="More YJA Episodes" />

==Official description==
''Nash and the young Jedi transport a princess. Kai's bad day worsens when a simple mission goes awry.''
